package.name: uavx_comms
package.description:
The mesh. None of the accepted simulators model radio, so the link model, the routing state machine and the relay election are the deliverable rather than configuration.
Chunk 2.3 builds the pure half: functions and state machines a unit test can drive with no ROS graph, no simulator and no wall clock. W3 wraps them in nodes that publish only to their own tx and subscribe only to their own rx, which is why nothing in this package names a topic or a vehicle id.
